deploy-bot: quality-guard triggered during rollout v4.1.0 -> metric: golden-prompt failure rate >= 3% over 10m. initiating automated rollback to v4.0.9 and starting traffic shift. :rotating_light:
leah: hold — this guard is new for scoring-based rollouts. FinanceBeta reported odd completions but asked us to keep their canary live while we inspect. can we pause the rollback and pin their routes instead?
tom: +1. prefer targeted mitigation: pin tenant routes to v4.0.9, maintain 5% canary on v4.1.0 with verbose scoring logs so ML team can reproduce errors.
eng-sre: current rollback progress: 12% (traffic ramp down in us-west-2). queued jobs: drain 3 hosts, update LB rules. need an explicit cancel if we stop rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback job 1743711111 is reversible. awaiting manual override. automated guard suppression requires owner approval.
mona: I approve suppression for FinanceBeta tenant only. @eng-sre please cancel global rollback and apply pin for tenant namespace `finbeta-prod` to v4.0.9. leave global rollout paused.
eng-sre: executing: `deployctl cancel 1743711111` -> success. `deployctl pin --tenant finbeta-prod --version v4.0.9 --reason "tenant requested debug window"` -> success, audit=pin-b7c2.
elliot: ML action items: increase trace sampling for that tenant to 100% for 1h, enable model debug headers, upload scoring logs to secure bucket. creating ticket ML-3274.
sales-beth: I'll notify FinanceBeta with a short note: "We're pausing the rollout for your traffic and collecting traces; no interruption expected. We'll share an update within 6 hours." Do we need an official release-note update or public comms?
leah: not public yet. update release notes internal draft: add note under v4.1.0: "paused rollout due to scoring regression for a subset of prompts; preserving stability for affected tenants while we investigate."
omitted-bot: (release-notes)
